title: Shiftwave Shopify staging queue
description: Field contract for ops/staging.json. Shopify tag sw-business is intake only. Rows reach public/locations.json only when status=approved AND consent=true AND visit_model is walk_in or appointment (none never publishes). Appointment rows publish with the flag. Tag sw-finder-exclude is a hard no.

demo.description: True for sample/fixture queues. Never true for a live customer export.

updated.description: ISO date or datetime of last stage/merge.

visitModel.description: Set at qualify. walk_in = listed (walk-ins welcome). appointment = listed with a call-to-schedule label. none = do not list / excluded from the public map.

id.description: Stable slug (company + locality). Preserved across re-imports.

consent.description: Partner agrees to receive public demo visitors. Required true to publish. HubSpot holds this when that object is live; until then reviewers set it here.

exclude.description: Hard no. True when Shopify tags include sw-finder-exclude.

qualified.description: Colin gate: this is a real try-spot, not merely a business buyer.

public_facing.description: Public business, not home / private use.

walk_in_ok.description: Compat: true when visit_model is walk_in. Appointment-only is visit_model=appointment — listed, not hidden.

state.description: USPS code preferred (CA), full name accepted.

hubspot_id.description: Optional HubSpot record id once consent/qualification live there.
